page.overview:
Who is Alexander Luthor?

Growing up in the United States, Lex Luthor displayed an incredible aptitude for science and genetics from a young age, studying at MIT As an adult, he rose to power as the CEO of LuthorCorp, which he transformed from a pesticides manufacturer into a billion-dollar tech empire by inventing one of the most efficient batteries on Earth.

His innovations revolutionized energy distribution across the globe, and led to LuthorCorp developing environmentally friendly and fuel-efficient cars. From LuthorCorp Tower in Metropolis, Delaware, Lex became widely renowned as an exceptional scientist and businessman, and his company came to compete for financial dominance with fellow megacorporations LordTech, Stagg Industries and Wayne Enterprises.

Around 2022, Superman, a powerful and friendly Kryptonian superhero, made his heroic debut in Metropolis and became its local protector, which caught the attention of Lex, who developed an obsessive feeling of envy against him due to people's fanaticism for him and considering him as a being superior to other humans, so he dedicated himself to carrying out various plans to destroy his reputation. Lex tried various ways to ruin his reputation, so he experimented with a pack of monkeys to act as bots on social media and started the #Supershit campaign to boycott the superhero. In an attempt to compete against Superman, he took one of the alien's hairs to create Ultraman, a clone identical to Superman. However, the clone turned out to be defective and with little brain capacity, but he decided to use it in his plans so that it would be able to fight the Kryptonian with his own combat movements that he recorded for any circumstance.

In his quest to defeat Superman, Lex founded PlanetWatch, a task force to confront dangerous alien threats like Superman and defend Earth, having as recruits Ultraman, The Engineer, real name Angela Spica, a metahuman who could deploy weapons through the nanites in her blood, and the Raptors, a squad of soldiers with advanced armor. Behind the public's back, Lex created several dimensional portals to connect the LuthorCorp Tower and the abandoned Fort Kramer to his pocket universe, which he created through a multi-collider, to use as a personal prison to contain people scorned by world governments by his associates and his ex-girlfriends who turned against him.
